description: This file is a code-behind for the Dashboard web page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It handles events for various buttons to navigate between pages such as user profile, leaderboard, start exam, and login.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: A code-behind class for the Dashboard page, handling page load and button click events to navigate within the online examination system.

methods.description: Event handler for the page load event. Currently does not contain any logic.
